about: How the measured content coverage of a contract (content-coverage.json beside it, written by packages/cms/tracy-quickstart-tools/content-coverage) weighs on the Road to live step Content coverage. A hole is a piece of demo text, an image or a link a visitor sees that the content map does not declare. capture: the value sits in the site database (locked: the presentation lock pins its field, which keeps demo CONTENT the customer can never change, so it is still a hole; undeclared: in neither file). template: written in the template's own files or language strings. core: Joomla or framework strings, never a hole. unknown: found in no source the audit could read. Page hygiene (hygiene list): things a customer must never see, found in the same crawl: a raw language constant, PHP error text, an unfilled placeholder; what counts as one is packages/cms/tracy-quickstart-tools/content-coverage/hygiene-rules.json. Edit this file to change the threshold; no code change is needed.

reasons.platforms: Only the Joomla audit exists (it reads the Joomla database dump and template sources); holes and page hygiene of a WordPress or EmDash contract are not measured yet.
reasons.rolesPlatforms: ADR 0038: the slot roles group is judged for every platform that binds slot roles, whether or not the audit measures it: a new release without roles is held from Publish, a live one warns.
reasons.blockingClasses: Start strict (owner, 24/10/2026): every unexplained hole a customer could not change through the contract holds Publish. Joomla core strings never do.
reasons.lockedCaptureIsHole: Only true presentation may be locked; demo text or images pinned by the lock stay on the customer's site for good.
reasons.maxUnacceptedHoles: Any hole without an accepted reason holds Publish; raise this only by a decision of the owner.
reasons.maxFailedPages: A page that did not render was not measured, so the result is incomplete.
reasons.capReachedHolds: The page cap cut the crawl: pages were left unmeasured.
reasons.blockingHygieneKinds: Owner, 24/10/2026: a raw constant, a PHP error or a placeholder on a page a customer gets is never fine; each holds Publish like a hole, and takes the same accepted reason only when it is not something a customer sees.
reasons.maxUnacceptedHygiene: Any page problem without an accepted reason holds Publish.
reasons.rolesHoldNewRelease: ADR 0038 decision Q2: a release not shown on Design inspiration whose content map leaves text or image slots without a role, or declares no roles at all (every template released before ADR 0038), is held from Publish; a release already shown only warns. Set false to make the roles group warn only.
reasons.minToolVersion: 1.1.0 measures page hygiene; a file from 1.0.0 never looked, so it is measured again.
